description: PRIMITIVE-SET VERSION REGISTRY (v3 prompt 8; ADR-0039; captain ratification waveb-design-ratification 2026-07-26). Mirrors src/contracts/primitives/catalog.ts - the primitive-catalog fence fails the build if the two disagree in either direction, so this file can never claim a vocabulary the code does not ship. The set version is pinned into every DecisionInputBundle.primitiveSetVersion and versions independently of the policy-AST grammar (prompt 9). PROVISIONAL: the vocabulary is expected to be falsified and revised; each primitive's kill criterion lives in docs/primitive-rationale.md. Declared future primitives arrive only through a version bump here, never as quiet catalog additions.
